test_title: PYST 13: SSC GD Constable 2024 - Reasoning (Held On: 23 Feb, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: Six persons P1, P2, P3, P4, P5 and P6 are sitting around a circular table facing towards the centre (not necessarily in the same order). Only two persons are sitting between P2 and P6 from the either sides. Only one person is sitting between P2 and P4. P5 is sitting to the immediate right of P3. P1 is sitting second to the right of P6. Who is sitting on the immediate right of P1?
solution:
According to the given information,

1) Only two persons are sitting between P2 and P6 from the either sides.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cf1eb1227bf8bceb79bfab0704ad2395ac38eecdd9b41685c51e54b8c0c19d52.png] 

2) P1 is sitting second to the right of P6.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/71e6c1629cdaecd60e4ad7eda4a0d0c33304903a987aabe7abba9180434e6c8f.png] 

3) Only one person is sitting between P2 and P4.

4) P5 is sitting to the immediate right of P3.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d28d9f9fbfc7a95f86d841d652feb752863cd29cd7770d6ab33ea4444468ebc3.png] 

Here, we can see that P2 is sitting on the immediate right of P1.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4"**.
